data: What is the approximate value of d (squared distance from typical pattern) where the green dashed line intersects the y-axis?

The green dashed line represents the Random Model with 1300 languages. To find the approximate value of d where this line intersects the y-axis, I need to look at the point where the line crosses the vertical axis on the left side of the graph. 

Looking at the graph, the green dashed line appears to intersect the y-axis at approximately 0.05. This can be verified by observing the position of the line relative to the y-axis scale.
